925K likes, 21K comments - iamsrk on July 1, 2026: "What started as a dream… turns into reality today.

Welcoming you all to the Knight Riders Cricket Ground, LA.

A place built not just for sports but also entertainment and for families… and memories that last forever. 

Special thanks to Jaybhai who has been too kind through this journey @JayShah220988, & @ICC and Sanjog Gupta for being so supportive. 

This is for LA, for cricket fans across the globe, and for the Knight Riders family. Believe in Purple and Gold. 

Welcome to the home of @lakriders".
